name: RC22 H1 (old): Loss Rebalancing (IS=0.005, VS=1.0)
result: 166a: 5/9 best, 4/9 final. S4 perfect (1.000), S8 median_bias PASS. But S2 still FAIL. IS reduction was the primary driver.

name: RC22 H1 (v2): Factorized Decoder with Split Conditioning
theory: Post-attention noise injection via L@eps prevents rank compression. Split conditioning via FiLM.
result: 167a: 5/9 (S3 regression). L_norm 0.08->0.01. Factor path died from: (1) CLN pathway competition, (2) weight decay 27x > gradient, (3) FiLM bug gamma*h+beta suppresses init, (4) oversized hidden layer 35,444x WD/grad ratio. L never developed 5-factor structure (always rank-2). Codex-verified x2.

name: RC22 H1 (v3): Clean Isolation Test — Factorized Without Confounds (Codex-designed)
theory: 167a had 4 confounded failure modes. This isolates whether L@eps can work by removing all 4: (1) freeze CLN to zero (remove competing path), (2) wd=0 for load_head+FiLM (remove kill mechanism), (3) fix FiLM to (1+gamma)*h+beta (identity at init), (4) simplify load_head to Linear(d_model, n_factors) (remove 35,444x WD first layer). If L wakes up → 167a was fixable. If L stays rank-2 → abandon factorized L@eps.
target: L_eff_rank > 3. Factor-only PC1 < 0.8. Factor-only spread grows over training.
kill_condition: L_eff_rank stays ~2. Factor-only PC1 > 0.8. Factor-only spread shrinks. S3 doesn't improve.
if_fails: Abandon factorized L@eps entirely. Move to explicit structure loss (-logdet(L^T L + εI)) or different approach.

name: RC22 H2: K Reduction (K=8, B=32)
theory: SOTA uses K=2-4. Our K=16 has centering/spread ratio 1.07. K=8 gives 1.14.
note: Neither Codex review recommends this as next. Does not address factor path failure mode. Keep queued for after H1v3 resolution.

name: RC22 H3: Encoder Contrastive Loss
theory: Encoder condition 98% shared. InfoNCE pushes regimes apart.
target: Encoder probe accuracy improvement. L variance across windows increases.
note: H1v2 showed L varied across windows (L_var=0.000046). Issue was not encoder discrimination. Codex: skip this, does not address factor path failure. Keep queued.

name: RC22 H4: Structure Loss on Factor Loadings (conditional on H1v3 failure)
theory: If L@eps cannot develop rank even without confounds, add explicit rank incentive: -logdet(L^T L + εI) or singular-value floor on L. afCRPS only rewards ||l_c|| (row norm), not orthogonality. A structure loss directly incentivizes L to span multiple factors. Codex-suggested.
kill_condition: Structure loss conflicts with CRPS (L grows rank but samples become unrealistic).
note: Only run if H1v3 fails. If H1v3 succeeds, we know the architecture works and just need the optimizer fixes.
